description: Logs incoming MIDI messages with their timing, and writes the log out as a text file.
notes: SysEx, SysEx Data and Clock start switched off, so those messages are not logged until they are switched on.
nothing is logged until a MIDI device is picked on the display at the top.
menu: Show engine frame — replaces the elapsed-seconds stamp on each line with the last six digits of the engine frame number.
Clear log — empties the display; Export log writes what the display holds to a text file.
MIDI channel messages — Note on/off, Key pressure, CC, CC (14-bit/RPN/NRPN), Program change, Channel pressure and Pitch wheel each switch those messages in the log on and off.
MIDI system messages — Clock, Other, SysEx and SysEx Data each switch those messages in the log on and off.
